name: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest private port operator (Mundra, Kandla, Krishnapatnam, Dhamra, Vizhinjam, Paradip berths etc.), with logistics (rail, warehousing), marine services and international ports (Haifa, Colombo, Tanzania, Australia; Oman subsidiary set up 2026-10-23). Four growth engines per company: domestic ports, logistics, marine, international. Q2 FY27 revenue +24%, EBITDA +23%, PAT Rs 3,682 cr (+18%); FY27 revenue and EBITDA guidance raised by Rs 1,000 cr each (2026-10-28). October cargo +27%. US$3.3 bn bid for Evos Terminals (2026-10-30). US criminal case against Gautam Adani dismissed on 2026-08-11. Market cap Rs 4.46 lakh cr, P/E 32.

revenue_mix.geography: Israel, Sri Lanka, Tanzania, Australia, Oman (model estimate)

exposures.mechanism: Port cargo grows ~1.3-1.5x GDP (October cargo +27% shows share gain/ mix). +1pp GDP -> cargo +1.5pp -> revenue +1.5%, operating margin 58% with high fixed costs (incremental ~75%) -> EBITDA +2.2% x EV/MCap 1.12 x persistence 0.7 => +1.7, rounded +1.6.
